events.name: Bash
events.head: Extract key candidates from commit without printing
events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign; mkdir -p ~/.config/tantra/keys && chmod 700 ~/.config/tantra/keys; git show 746afc0e:workshop-plan/tasks/inbox.jsonl | grep -oE 'tk_live_[A-Za-z0-9_]+' | sort -u > /tmp/.t056k; echo "candidates: $(wc -l < /tmp/.t056k)"; awk '{print length($0)}' /tmp/.t056k

events.name: Bash
events.head: Save key file and read script
events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign; umask 077; cp /tmp/.t056k ~/.config/tantra/keys/tantra-workshop.key; rm -f /tmp/.t056k; chmod 600 ~/.config/tantra/keys/tantra-workshop.key; ls -l ~/.config/tantra/keys/; sed -n 1,44p workshop-plan/ops/t056_cold_calendar.mjs; sed -n 70,149p workshop-plan/ops/t056_cold_calendar.mjs
